1981-2415-5686-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-8319.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

803-1168-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1168-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2174-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

141-3899-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3899-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-3899-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1939-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Luminous Phantom trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2178-5470-6495.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-5470-6495.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Evereth ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
2178-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5777-7313-7810.description:
Activate a Food by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food token due to Tippy-Toe
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Spark Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

413-792-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-792-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Totentanz and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

380-3839.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying its mana cost.
When Changeling Hero enters, its champion ability and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Hero.
When the Changeling Hero token enters, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Hero until the token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Changeling Hero trigger from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Hero.
The token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2800-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
2800-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Mirari's Wake triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
2800-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

2440-4478-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4478-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

2267-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4050-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1020-2866-4050-6709.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
Repeat.

967-3809-3967-5184-7087.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1719-2628-6100-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6100-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Elvish Regrower.
When Elvish Regrower enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

280-1479-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4050-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures, adding {1} for each one.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Repeat from 3.

3565-4424-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
3565-4424-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants, adding {R}.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2634-2997-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-2997-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4050-4241-4854-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4050-4241-4854-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing the Treasure to become a 1/1 artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

3525-4474-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

3927-4112.description:
Cast Sakashima's Protege by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Sakashima's Protege enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sakashima's Protege triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

1580-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
